name: storyreader
description: StoryReader — installable PWA for branded story libraries (read + listen + offline + sync)

scripts.dev:holdfast: npm run build -w app -- --mode holdfast && wrangler dev --env holdfast
scripts.dev:gunner: npm run build -w app -- --mode gunner && wrangler dev --env gunner
scripts.deploy:holdfast: npm run build:holdfast && wrangler deploy --env holdfast
scripts.deploy:gunner: npm run build:gunner && wrangler deploy --env gunner
